create_experiment_cifar10: create an xmanager experiment titled cifar10 using xm_local.create_experiment
build_python_container: build a PythonContainer spec with base image, entrypoint module name, and package path
package_executable: package an executable with PythonContainer spec, Vertex executor spec, and empty args
